activity_summary: Heminges named your share as eight-and-twenty shillings, against four-and-thirty last Saturday. James said the house stands, and that was the news. No extra was paid for the slippers. You did not count the chest. Nothing was said of Allen. You left in time to be home for the call.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named eight-and-twenty, refused extras, and shut the book.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Said the house stood, and brought no other news.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Refused an average, and wanted supper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Repeated the number, left the chest uncounted, and went home.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Took the share, and kept a second bowl off the sheet.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Claimed the noise, took the same share, and left.

facets.activity: Took eight-and-twenty shillings and heard the house stands

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: The house stands. That is the news

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not counting the chest in this room
